findings.title: Progress ShareFile Storage Zone Controller — Vendor-Mandated Emergency Shutdown Over 'Credible External Security Threat' (2026-07-10; No CVE Assigned; Possible New Zero-Day Or Live Exploitation Of April CVE-2026-2699/2701 Chain)
findings.affected_technology: Progress ShareFile — on-prem Windows Storage Zone Controllers (SZC); historical link to unpatched watchTowr CVE-2026-2699 auth-bypass + CVE-2026-2701 RCE chain from April 2026
findings.summary: Progress emailed ShareFile customers 2026-07-09/10 to shut down Windows Storage Zone Controllers over a 'credible external security threat' and temporarily disabled SZC-backed account access; whether new zero-day or live exploitation of April CVE-2026-2699/2701 chain is undisclosed and the shutdown-not-patch response signals no available fix.

findings.title: Gitea CVE-2026-20896 (CVSS 9.8) Docker-Image Default REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES=* Turns X-WEBAUTH-USER Header Into One-Header Admin Impersonation; Active Exploitation From 2026-07-07 (~13 Days After Disclosure), ProtonVPN Probe Node Observed
findings.affected_technology: Gitea official Docker image ≤ 1.26.2 (default config with reverse-proxy auth enabled)
findings.summary: Gitea's Docker image default trusts X-WEBAUTH-USER from any source when reverse-proxy auth is on, letting a remote attacker impersonate gitea_admin with one header; Michael Clark confirmed active exploitation from 2026-07-07 (~13 days post-advisory) — upgrade to 1.26.4.

findings.title: Zimbra ZCS 10.1.19 — Critical Stored XSS In Classic Web Client Reported By Google TAG (No CVE Assigned); Open-Email Trigger, APT29/APT28 History Of Zimbra XSS Exploitation
findings.affected_technology: Zimbra Collaboration Suite < 10.1.19 (Classic/Ajax Web Client only)
findings.summary: Zimbra shipped 10.1.19 on 2026-07-08 to patch a Google-TAG-reported stored XSS in the Classic Web Client where a crafted email executes JavaScript on message open, yielding session/mailbox theft; TAG involvement + Zimbra's APT29/APT28 XSS-exploitation history strongly implies state-sponsored ITW.

findings.title: OpenClaw 2026.6.6 — Three GHSAs (CVSS 8.4–8.8) Chain WhatsApp Message → Host Code Execution: sanitizeEnvVars() Denylist Bypass Via NODE_OPTIONS/BASH_ENV/PYTHONSTARTUP + Sandbox Bind-Mount Path Traversal (GHSA-hjr6-g723-hmfm, GHSA-9969-8g9h-rxwm, GHSA-575v-8hfq-m3mc)
findings.affected_technology: OpenClaw self-hosted AI assistant ≤ 2026.6.5 (WhatsApp / Slack / Discord / Telegram / Teams bridges)
findings.summary: Researcher Chinmohan Nayak chained three OpenClaw flaws — env-var denylist bypass (NODE_OPTIONS/BASH_ENV/PYTHONSTARTUP) + sandbox bind-mount path traversal — so an inbound WhatsApp message reaches host code execution and mounts /home /var, exposing SSH/AWS/Docker; patched in 2026.6.6.

findings.title: XQUIC 'XRING' HTTP/3 Denial-of-Service — 260-Byte QPACK Traffic Crashes Any Server Embedding XQUIC ≤ 1.9.4 (No Patch, No CVE); Affects Tengine And Alibaba's CDN Fronting Taobao / Alipay
findings.affected_technology: Alibaba XQUIC ≤ 1.9.4 QUIC/HTTP/3 library; Tengine (Alibaba's Nginx-based web server); any HTTP/3 endpoint embedding XQUIC with default QPACK settings
findings.summary: FoxIO's Sébastien Féry disclosed 2026-07-08 that a single-line variable-shadow in XQUIC's QPACK dynamic-table handling lets ~260 bytes of legal HTTP/3 traffic crash the server process unauthenticated; no patch and no CVE — set SETTINGS_QPACK_MAX_TABLE_CAPACITY=0 or drop HTTP/3 until XQUIC 1.9.5.

findings.title: Squidbleed CVE-2026-47729 — Correction: Fix Was NOT In Squid 7.6, Scheduled For Squid 7.7 (Amos Jeffries Clarification 2026-06-15, Mainstream Schneier Surfacing 2026-07-10); Our 2026-06-13 Coverage Incorrectly Stated 7.6 Patched This CVE
findings.affected_technology: Squid caching proxy — FTP gateway parser; every Squid release including 7.6 (fix pending in 7.7)
findings.summary: Squid maintainer Amos Jeffries corrected on oss-security 2026-06-15 that Squid 7.6 did NOT ship the CVE-2026-47729 Squidbleed FTP-gateway fix (only CVE-2026-50012 cache-digests overflow) — the null-terminator patch is queued for 7.7; operators who upgraded to 7.6 remain exposed and must apply commit 865a131c or disable FTP gateway.
